links.outcome: Main diagnostic accuracy of LLMs versus emergency junior physicians on same real cases
links.effect: DeepSeek-V3 (90.0%), ChatGPT-4o (86.0%), Grok3 (86.0%) significantly higher than EDJP (77.5%, p<0.05); LLM comprehensiveness scores all higher than EDJP; LLMs faster (6.3-14.0 s vs 360.2 s).
links.quote: Main diagnostic accuracy: DeepSeek-V3 (90.0%), ChatGPT-4o (86.0%), and Grok3 (86.0%) were significantly higher than that of EDJP (77.5%, p < 0.05); in the subgroup of respiratory system diseases, Gemini-2.0 and DeepSeek-V3 performed better (p < 0.05).

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing the diagnostic performance of 5 commercial LLMs versus junior emergency physicians on 154 anonymized clinical cases. It does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
